item.title: Watch DD India in your Country
item.description: Here’s how DTH providers in different countries can downlink Indian public broadcaster’s global TV channel, DD India, on their platforms. SDTV Broadcast is available through the satellite GSAT-17@93.5°E. Downlink parameters are as follows: Frequency-3925 mHz, Polarisation-H, FEC-3/4, symbol rate-27.5 mbps, Compression- MPEG-2, Modulator- DVB-S-QPSK HDTV Broadcast is available through the satellite GSAT-10@83.0°E.
